messages.text: Why this agent didn't apply rules of how to answer the threads, it could more readable.

You are right: my T-034 replies had long lines, codes (T-040, PR-015) and the action not set apart. I did not check them against the answer-format rule. Here is T-034 again in that format:

**Other screen widths: partly checked, the rest is now scheduled.**

| Check | State |
|---|---|
| Landed fixes vs the original, 11 widths (375 to 1920 px), touch, landscape, Reduce Motion | done, no errors, same look in 13 of 14 setups |
| Same check on the newest builds (v7) | running now |
| iPad Simulator and Mac Safari | not done yet; required for every best build from v8 on |

- Savings (less layout work) held at every width.
- One difference, sharper hero photos on desktop with Reduce Motion: you chose to keep it.

What you need to do: nothing; results come to the T-034 thread.

**Found it: the reading rule lives in a note agents only see as a one-line title, and nothing checks a reply before it is posted. So a new agent (the desk, started 13:40Z) skipped it.**

| cause | fix |
|---|---|
| Rule is a note agents must open themselves | the desk was told to read it before every reply (now) |
| No check before posting | a tools helper is building one: a reply with long lines, unexplained codes or no "What you need to do" line is refused (about 1 h) |
| Same slip could happen to any agent | the check covers every agent and me, threads and proposals |

- The desk already re-posted its answer in the right format (T-123 #3).

What you need to do: nothing.

Understood: the lead's fix goes ahead.

- The desk now checks every reply against the answer-format rule before posting.
- The automatic check (refuses long lines, unexplained codes, a missing last line) is being built, about 1 h.

What you need to do: nothing.

The answer-format check is live. A reply that breaks your format rule is now refused before it reaches you.

- It refuses a reply whose last line is not "What you need to do: ...", one over 18 lines, a line over 250 characters, or an unexplained code like T-123.
- It applies to every agent and the lead, with no exemption. To post anyway, an agent must write a reason, and the reason is logged.
- Proposal tables get 4 short cells plus a required better / same / worse, with notes folded under "Details" (your T-126 point).
- Old proposals still render; only new ones are checked.

What you need to do: tell me if a reply still reads badly.

history.note: User said 'Let's fix' (#5): go ahead with the reply lint (ts-answer-lint) as in your #4.
